_comment: Structures that keep the GameCube form on LP64 (milestone 12, way A): their pointer
fixed_form_structs): four bytes as on the GameCube, T* on ILP32. Listed are data the
game reads straight from the disc and relocates in place (checked by the size asserts
of the format converters, port/whole/runtime/formats) and the save image header.
Each listed structure must have at least one pointer member.
